summary: Freight Technologies filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, announcing a 1-for-5 reverse stock split approved by its board on April 27, 2026. Effective May 18, 2026, each five pre-split ordinary shares combine into one, reducing outstanding shares from 2,860,626 to 572,125; no fractional shares are issued (rounding up for holders above one-half, canceling below). The split aims to raise the per-share price above $1.00 to maintain Nasdaq listing, with Transhare as exchange agent. This is a capital-structure adjustment, not a transformative event—watch trading post-split for continued compliance.
